One small group of three parallel / hatch marks only where needed. Sparse surface marks; NO all-over hatching, stippling, granular texture or speckled wash. Upper-left daylight. SUBJECT: one broad low dome of packed dark earth covering a radial log stack; small wood ends visible through one southern opening, tiny top vent. UNLIT, intact earth covering, no smoke.
